:::{#thm-exp-hazard}

#### Constant hazard of the exponential distribution

If $T$ has an [exponential distribution](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/random-variables.html#def-exponential) with rate $\lambda > 0$,
then for $t \ge 0$:

$$\haz(t) = \lambda$$

In other words, the exponential distribution has **constant hazard**.

:::

::: proof

This proof is the solution to @exr-review-exp-dist.

:::
